title: Facts file
description: A list of facts on one topic (content/facts/<topic>.json). PLAN.md section 6.2. Every historical claim the site shows lives here with its source. scripts/check-sources.js enforces the sourcing rules, so the schema itself only requires id and statement.

statement.description: The fact as the site shows it. Typographic quotes and apostrophes (’ “ ”).

sourceId.description: Use instead of "source" to cite an entry in content/sources/sources.json.

sourceLocation.description: With sourceId: where in the document, e.g. "p. 45" or "map 8".

verifiedOn.description: The date someone last checked this statement against the source.

disagreement.description: Null when sources agree. When they don't, record every version and say which one the site shows.

needsVerification.description: true when nobody could confirm this yet. The check lists these as warnings (errors with --strict).

leaderNote.description: Context for leaders only; never shown on the projector.

alternatives.description: The other versions, each with its own source.

siteDisplays.description: Which version the site shows and why, e.g. "The fact's own statement (the Trust's figure); the alternatives appear in the leader note."

teachingNote.description: Optional: how to use the disagreement as a lesson on how history gets counted.
